evaluation.note: Real service normalization and public Model.Info schema encode/decode. Eligible routes have a declared locally registered adapter and limits; no credentials, inference, pricing invoice or deployed browser validation were used.

behaviorCovered: Valid V1 cache behavior and byte-identical refresh suppression remain intact; legacy caches without a digest still upgrade.
Configured V2 sources keep exact model IDs and separate canonical identities, payload digest and format.
Per-API capabilities preserve true, false and unknown values; disabling tools or reasoning clears inherited controls.
Remote SDK declarations and specialized APIs do not authorize executable chat adapters.
Prices retain modality, unit, currency, denominator, cache TTLs, reasoning rates, overrides and multipliers.
Missing or nonrepresentable token estimates remain absent; free requires known zero input/output/cache and no declared auxiliary charges.
Structurally invalid catalogs, negative base prices and invalid consumed capability types cannot replace a valid cache.
Positive effort declarations do not enable cache optimization; replay_reasoning is not converted to requireReasoning.
Recursive catalog JSON arrays remain editable in owned plugin drafts without changing shared source data or sibling Locations.
limits: Default sources and bundled snapshot remain V1; V2 is available through configured sources.
Only unconditional token rates supported by the legacy estimator are projected to Model.Info.cost. Conditional/media evaluation and historical numeric cost projections remain migration work.
Unknown or unsupported estimates must not be interpreted as zero billing; no invoice or provider availability verification occurred.
Models without a local declared chat adapter or usable published limits are not eligible chat routes. Media, evaluation, decision and reranking invocation remain separate integration work.
The 20 Schema tests are the presentation subset. Existing broad contract-hygiene debt is recorded in task-integration-application-2026-10-23-validation.json and was not fixed in this batch.
